page_title: TOR 2-1 SAS | Torino v Sassuolo 06/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replacing Daniel Boloca.
90+3' Torino take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
90+1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) replaces Armand Lauriente.
86' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
85' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 20:4.
83' Here is a change. Antonio Sanabria is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Nemanja Radonjic (Torino).
83' Here's the change. Raoul Bellanova leaves the pitch and Valentino Lazaro (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
81' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Andrea Consigli makes a save.
81' Duvan Zapata (Torino) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
80' Alessio Dionisi decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
79' The referee signals a substitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Kristian Thorstvedt.
75' Duvan Zapata (Torino) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
72' Ivan Ilic (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Andrea Consigli comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
71' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

68' 2 - 1 Goal! Adrien Tameze displays great vision and sends a pass to Nikola Vlasic (Torino), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
67' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows for a foul.

66' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the left post and ricochets away.
65' A pass from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is intercepted by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic and the move breaks down.
63' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli is alert and denies him.
63' Ivan Ilic (Torino) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
59' Some great controlled play and passing from Torino. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
55' An attempted cross from Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is cleared.
54' What was Antonio Sanabria (Torino) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
52' Karol Linetty (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andrea Consigli, who smothers the ball.
52' Ivan Ilic (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
51' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:2.
48' Flag up against Nikola Vlasic (Torino). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
48' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
46' Half-time substitution. Alessio Dionisi decided to make a change. Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is replaced by Uros Racic.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Ivan Ilic (Torino) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
45+4' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Adrien Tameze (Torino) inside the box.

45+4' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom right corner. His promising effort is kept out by Andrea Consigli, who pulls off a stunning save!
45+2' Duvan Zapata (Torino) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

45+1' Duvan Zapata (Torino) unleashes a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Andrea Consigli thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Ricardo Rodriguez is substituted due to injury. Ivan Juric gives a chance to David Zima (Torino).
42' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) dribbles into the box, but Andrea Consigli is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
39' Duvan Zapata (Torino) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
39' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
37' It's a nice effort by Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Andrea Consigli. Easy save.
36' An accurate cross picks out Duvan Zapata (Torino) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
34' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
32' What a miss! The corner finds Raoul Bellanova (Torino) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
32' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
29' 5:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.

25' Andrea Consigli pulls off a decent save! Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
24' Foul! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
22' Torino players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

18' 1 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) and Domenico Berardi gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the left side of the goal. 1:1.
16' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
14' Duvan Zapata (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
13' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
11' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
11' The ball is cleared after Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Samuele Ricci is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nikola Vlasic (Torino).
7' The game is interrupted now, Samuele Ricci (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Adrien Tameze tees up Antonio Sanabria (Torino) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
4' The ball is crossed into the box and Antonio Sanabria (Torino) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli gets a glove on it to thwart him.
4' Some neat passing and movement from Torino as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
3' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
3' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
2' A brilliant cross into the box finds Mergim Vojvoda (Torino), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Torino will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
The referee of today's match will be Maria Ferrieri Caputi.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
